title: The Peshwas
definition: The Peshwas were the hereditary Prime Ministers of the Maratha Empire who transformed the state from a monarchy into a confederacy, shifting the power center from the Chhatrapati to the Peshwa office in Pune.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the transition of power in 18th-century India, the Maratha-British conflicts, and the administrative evolution of the Maratha Confederacy.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of The Peshwas.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
